title: Recording: Drowning In The Sea Of Love by Ringo Starr | 1977
content:
Atlantic Studios, New York City
Producer: Arif Mardin
Engineer: Lew Hahn

Ringo Starr began recording ‘Drowning In The Sea Of Love’ for his sixth studio album, Ringo The 4th, on 26 January 1977.

‘Drowning In The Sea Of Love’ had originally been recorded in 1971 by Joe Simon as the title track of his seventh album. It was written by Kenny Gamble and Leon Huff, pioneers of the Philly soul sound of the 1970s.

Starr’s version was the first UK single released from Ringo The 4th, with the non-album song ‘Just A Dream’ on the b-side.
